_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Prometheus egg in pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Prometheus
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Prometheus is a monitoring system and time series database. Its settings are in prometheus.yml, and the web interface is on the server's port.

config.startup: {"done": ["Server is ready to receive web requests."]}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Prometheus: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub and
# checks its checksum. prometheus.yml, web.yml and the data folder are
# never touched; only the prometheus and promtool programs are replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac

want="${PROMETHEUS_VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag prometheus/prometheus "$tag") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 3.5.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"
name="prometheus-$version.linux-$arch.tar.gz"

if [ -x prometheus ] && ./prometheus --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "version $version "; then
    echo "Prometheus $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Prometheus $version"
    gh-release download prometheus/prometheus "$tag" "$name" $work/prometheus.tar.gz
    mkdir .raptor-new
    tar -xzf $work/prometheus.tar.gz -C .raptor-new --strip-components=1
    for f in prometheus promtool; do mv -f ".raptor-new/$f" "./$f"; done
    rm -rf .raptor-new $work/prometheus.tar.gz
fi

mkdir -p data
if [ ! -f prometheus.yml ]; then
    cat > prometheus.yml <<EOF
# Prometheus's settings: https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/configuration/
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

scrape_configs:
  # Prometheus itself.
  - job_name: prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["localhost:${SERVER_PORT:-9090}"]
EOF
fi
if [ ! -f web.yml ]; then
    cat > web.yml <<'EOF'
# Password protection and TLS for the web interface:
# https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/https/
EOF
fi
echo "Installed Prometheus $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Prometheus version to install, such as 3.5.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Data retention
variables.description: How long metrics are kept, such as 15d, 12h or 1y.
